rows.grounds: compound of abundant and homa in instrumental singular
locative singular of sahārtha, companion sense

items.question: Why is the instrumental case used with abundant homa?
items.inference: The verse states the third case conveys companion sense with abundant homa.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation of bhūrihomena to tṛtīyā is not explicit.
items.plain_english: With abundant homa; thus the third (instrumental) case is used in the sense of accompaniment.
